reason: no independent judgments exist (queue prepared, not collected); unreviewed outputs and automated proxies cannot unlock distillation

procedure.needs: independent judgments (data/e06/review/judgments.tsv by a reviewer who is not a model or the agent) on the blinded queue
procedure.unit: primary-track pool word; a system's top-1 is accepted if judged acceptable ('uncertain' = not accepted; sensitivity: uncertain = accepted)
procedure.comparison: paired: reference (byt5_lora) top-1 accepted − baseline (default_e02) top-1 accepted, per word
procedure.interval: family bootstrap (pool words are one family each), 10,000 resamples, seed 20261027, 95% percentile
pass_if: reference accepted count > baseline accepted count
net advantage not confined: positive difference in at least 3 categories and no category supplies more than half of the net wins
malformed, translations (judged comments) and unsupported cases reported
procedure.otherwise: teacher_advantage_unresolved (insufficient sample or interval) or teacher_not_better
